core_idea: The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather Yi Sang is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling.
playstyle_guide:
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **"Raise and Laugh the Blade, Cry the Waterfall Like the Scent of Fallen Leaves"** — **S1 — "Enwrap 330 Times in Long Swaths of Frozen Blood"** adds **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin; **S2 — "Revel with Soundless Applause, Impale in Voiceless Sorrow"** adds **+3 Poise** at **On Use** and **+1 Poise Count** per **On Hit** coin.
- **"Raise and Laugh the Blade, Cry the Waterfall Like the Scent of Fallen Leaves"** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — "Enwrap 330 Times in Long Swaths of Frozen Blood"** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low / High stacked).
- (75 - (Karmic Consequence / 2))% chance to produce a Blunt weapon ; - Coins using Blunt weapons deal +15% damage ; If this Skill is marked with Mark of the Prescript, Clash Power +1 and deal +20% damage ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Sinking on target) (max 2) ; [On Use] Convert Coins equal to (Unlock stage - 1) into Unbreakable Coins, beginning with the final Coin ; [On Use] Gain + 2 Poise Count
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition

**S2 — "Revel with Soundless Applause, Impale in Voiceless Sorrow"** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- (75 - (Karmic Consequence / 2))% chance to produce a Pierce weapon ; - Coins using Pierce weapons deal +15% damage ; If this Skill is marked with Mark of the Prescript, Final Power +1 ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Sinking on target) (max 2) ; [On Use] Convert Coins equal to (Unlock stage) into Unbreakable Coins, beginning with the final Coin ; [On Use] Gain 3 Poise
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- Gain +1 Poise Count; [On Hit without Cracking] Inflict +1 Sinking Count

**S3 — "Raise and Laugh the Blade, Cry the Waterfall Like the Scent of Fallen Leaves"** (BP 4, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low / High stacked).
- Turn Start: At 9 Procuration — Hermes —, replace this Skill with "Furioso-Replica" (once per turn) ; - Prioritizes the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row on the Dashboard ; - [Before Use] At less than 9 Procuration — Hermes —, use as Skill 3 ; (75 - (Karmic Consequence / 2))% chance to produce a Slash weapon ; - Coins using Slash weapons deal +25% damage ; If this Skill is marked with Mark of the Prescript, deal +20% damage ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Sinking on target) (max 2) ; [On Use] Convert Coins equal to (Unlock stage + 1) into Unbreakable Coins, beginning with the final Coin ; [On Use] Gain +3 Poise Count ; - Gain additional Poise equal to (Unlock stage)
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- Deal +10% damage for every Unlock stage (max 30%); [On Crit] Gain +1 Poise Count; [On Hit without Cracking] Inflict +2 Sinking Count

*↳ Alternate S3 — Furioso-Replica* (BP 3, CP +3): rolls — low 3, high 30 (Extremely High).

Combat passive — **Prescript Delivered on a Device**: Turn Start:.
  - Gain Prescript: — Device — I (Yi Sang) / Prescript: — Device — II (Yi Sang) / Prescript: — Device — III (Yi Sang) / Prescript: — Device —….
  - Inflict The Prescript's Target to a random enemy (in Focused Encounters, a Part).

Combat passive — **Imitation of a Life**: req3=1 Owned Deal +2% damage with Skills marked with Mark of the Prescript for every Grace of the Prescript on self (max 16%).
  - At 9 Grace of the Prescript, deal +20% damage with Base Skills instead.
  - On Hit with Base Attack Skill's Unbreakable Coins, gain 1 Procuration — Hermes —.

Defense skill — **Evade: By Unpredictable Whim**: At Unlock — III, Coin Power +2.
  - [Combat Start] Gain +2 Poise Count (once per turn).
  - [On Evade] Gain 2 Poise (2 times per turn).
  - [Turn End] At below Unlock — II, activate the following effects (once per Encounter):.
